import sys

def solve6():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    arr = list(s)
    count = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(arr)
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j < n and arr[j] == arr[i]:
            j += 1
        if (j - i) % 2 == 0:
            count += 1
        i = j
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve6()
